This is an estimate of how elevated your heart rate was while you were still and awake, compared with your own usual calm level. It is not a measure of how you feel.
Minutes while you were moving, in a workout or asleep are left out. A minute without a heart rate is left empty, not guessed.
Each still minute gets a level from 0 to 3: under 1 is low, 1 to under 2 is medium, 2 or more is high. These cut-offs are Apex\'s own choices and are not validated against any clinical measure.
Your calm level is built from your own recent days, so stress shows as calibrating until enough days exist.
